status: metadata-only feasibility upper bound; no announced-QB cohort, forecast, fit or target grade
scope: 2024 retained FanDuel receiving-yard quotes only. Explicit CSV usecols prevent target performance, participation and eventual QB labels from loading. Roster team/position/week are identity-context metadata only; not causal availability evidence.

rules.price: Finite American prices with absolute value >=100, both decimals 1.20–6.00, paired overround 0–12%; finite line, integer lines retained and flagged.
rules.timing: Original actual_snapshot_time; both book and market update ages 0–300 seconds inclusive, source snapshot strictly before minimum provider/independent scheduled kickoff. No clock shifted forward.
rules.fixture: 2024 REG ordered full-team mapping and unique independent kickoff within 15 minutes of source start, matching earlier NFL fixture semantics. Independent local gametime interpreted America/New_York with DST.
rules.identity: Existing NFL normalization of roster full_name: accent/punctuation removal and Jr/Sr/II/III/IV suffix removal. Exactly one nonmissing GSIS ID; no aliases or eventual participation filter.
rules.roster_team_context: Team set from retrospective roster, intersected with fixture teams; unique intersection reported for feasibility only. It is not prequote membership or a further price gate.
rules.dedup: Existing event/player/line/snapshot keys are unique, but six qualified game/player pairs have two different line/time rows across three events. Inventory preserves every row and reports distinct player-games; no earlier/later offer selected here.

limitations: No original API responses or unmerged source odds CSV; retained prices are conditional publisher-reported offers. Collector code passes prices through, but duplicate same-side keys can overwrite prices while preserving first clock metadata; no evidence whether it occurred.

Roster identities/team/position rows are retrospective, with no original prequote roster receipt; unique name identification does not establish prequote club membership, receiver health or participation.

No injury-replacement QB labels, announced starter evidence, prior air-yard roles, receiver-injury exclusions, episode persistence or overrides were evaluated. All inventory counts are upper bounds, not model-eligible exposures.

Most events have one snapshot; six reported receiving-yard events have multiple source snapshot times. Six qualifying player-games have two lines/times; preserve them in inventory and choose a deterministic earliest-valid rule before any cohort/model use. No causal announcement response, suspension state, accepted fills or exact historical jurisdiction terms are proven.

Future/history features must filter independently completed prior games before each quote and exclude current/later game values; schema availability alone does not establish historical publication timestamps.
Archive sporting values were inspected in prior unrelated work; this inventory reads none and cannot create an untouched holdout.

Per-team roster-compatible counts are provisional attribution counts, not guaranteed complete team-specific upper bounds: unresolved traded-player rows can belong to a target team. Use the full fixture distinct-player count as the fully conservative team-game ceiling until prior-observable team membership is established.

dedup_addendum.application: Inventory remains inclusive of all qualifying quotes; later episode join must apply the frozen earliest-price-qualified post-announcement entry and exact-time multiline exclusion, counting unique receiver-games.

prior_role_chronology_notes.weekly_stats: Header supports lagged receiving-air-yard and target roles, but has no game_id, exact game/start time or original publication/availability field. Join season/week/team/opponent to independent calendar; no non-null/valid-value coverage measured.
prior_role_chronology_notes.pbp_projections: Both 2024 projections omit receiver identity and air_yards; original QS or a new justified projection is needed.
prior_role_chronology_notes.full_2024_pbp_vintage: Retained QS release created 2025-09-03T09:25:06Z, updated 09:25:07Z and captured 2026-09-09T00:12:08Z per existing receipt. This retrospective asset cannot establish contemporaneous 2024 publication availability.
prior_role_chronology_notes.earlier_season_pbp: Full 2022 and 2023 PBP CSV.gz sources remain in nfl-qb-kneel-props-2026-09-26 and schemas include receiver identity/air_yards; no values read for this inventory.
